newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan-US consortium wins 10 bln yen Turkish order.
newsitem.headline: Japan-US consortium wins 10 bln yen Turkish order.

text.p: NKK Corp and Marubeni Corp said on Tuesday they were part of an international consortium that had won an order worth a total of around 10 billion yen from Turkey's state-owned steel producer for steel treatment equipment.

Other members of the group are Mitsubishi Electric Corp and Itam Techint Italimpianti Inc (Itam) of the United States, the companies said. The equipment will be installed at Eregli Iron and Steel Works Co in Eregli, Turkey, with operations starting by September 1999.
The facilities will consist of lines for cleaning and shearing steel, as well as electric tinning and chrome plating, an NKK spokesman said. Itam is a Pittsburgh-based engineering company, he added.
